formula: Both points are projected into the ORIGIN's LGRS CRS (lgrs/pyproj, default constraints). dE = destinationEN[0] - originEN[0], dN = destinationEN[1] - originEN[1]. expectedBearing = degrees(atan2(dE, dN)) normalised to [0, 360) (grid north = +N, clockwise toward +E). expectedRange = hypot(dE, dN) in metres.
